### 
10. Why are some agencies not accepting eAadhaar and insist on original Aadhaar?
![expand](https://uidai.gov.in/assets/svgs/AccordionArrow.svg)
  * ![arrow](https://uidai.gov.in/assets/svgs/icons/ArrowBullet.svg)
eAadhaar (downloaded Aadhaar) from UIDAI website is as legally valid as original Aadhaar issued by UIDAI.
  * ![arrow](https://uidai.gov.in/assets/svgs/icons/ArrowBullet.svg)
eAadhaar, Aadhaar Letter or Aadhaar Profile, all should be accepted by all Agencies.
  * ![arrow](https://uidai.gov.in/assets/svgs/icons/ArrowBullet.svg)
In fact, downloaded eAadhaar or Aadhaar profile have updated details of the Aadhaar number holders and therefore, these should be preferable.
  * ![arrow](https://uidai.gov.in/assets/svgs/icons/ArrowBullet.svg)
If any official/ agency/ department refuses to accept downloaded eAadhaar, the Aadhaar number holder may lodge complaint with the concerned authorities of those departments/ agencies.
